features.name: Swipe to keep or delete
features.description: Full-screen card of one photo or video: swipe right to keep, swipe left to mark for deletion; label appears on the card while dragging. Header shows the photo age ('58 sec fa'), an info button and a position counter (2/225) with undo.
features.reason: The app's core. SwiftUI DragGesture plus PhotoKit; on device.

features.name: Month by month timeline
features.description: Home is a vertical list of months (newest first). Each row shows progress (pie fills as the month is reviewed); finished months are struck through.
features.reason: PHFetchOptions with creationDate ranges; progress stored locally.

features.name: Recents and random queues
features.description: Extra entries on top of the timeline: recent photos with a badge of unreviewed count, and a shuffled random queue.
features.reason: Simple PhotoKit fetches; random order on device.

features.name: On This Day
features.description: Queue of photos taken on today's date in past years, with a small calendar of days that have photos, and a daily streak counter.
features.reason: PhotoKit date predicate. A streak is gamification; the queue itself is fine.

features.name: Review before delete
features.description: After finishing a batch, a grid shows everything marked; tap a tile to restore it; one button deletes all. Then the system confirmation and Recently Deleted.

features.name: Bookmarks / maybe pile
features.description: Set aside a photo you are unsure about to decide later.

features.name: Tap to go back, long press for metadata
features.description: Tap goes to previous card; long press shows date, place, size, camera.
features.reason: PHAsset properties and PHAssetResource; on device.

features.name: Favourite and share from card
features.description: Heart toggles favourite in Photos; share sheet.

features.name: Albums cleanup
features.description: List of user albums to swipe through one album at a time.

features.name: Statistics
features.description: Photos deleted and space saved for the batch and in total.
features.reason: Local counters; the space saved is the one figure.

features.name: Video playback in swipe
features.description: Videos play inline on the card so they can be judged before deleting.
features.reason: AVPlayer; a review says videos did not play and were deleted by mistake.

features.name: On This Day widget
features.description: Home screen widget showing a memory from today in past years.
features.reason: WidgetKit with photo thumbnail; reading the photo library from a widget needs care with the app group cache.

features.name: Memories map
features.description: Globe or map with photos placed by location.
features.reason: Not cleaning; outside the app's one job (MapKit tiles also hit the network).

features.name: AI photo enhancement
features.description: Sharpen or upscale old, blurry photos with a before/after slider.
features.reason: Server-side AI in the original; not cleaning.

features.name: Supercut videos
features.description: Generate a video montage from a month of photos.
features.reason: Not cleaning; outside the one job.

features.name: Themes, trophies, Wrapped
features.description: Colour themes, trophy room, yearly summary.
features.reason: Gamification and colour themes against design system and one-job rule.

features.name: Subscription, swipe limit and ads
features.description: Free tier limited (7-10 deletions then wait about 8 hours) or watch an ad; weekly/yearly premium with 3-day trial.
features.reason: No subscriptions, limits or ads in Sbu.

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.purpose: Explain swipe, ask access, show paywall
elements: Soft paywall with 3-day trial, weekly and yearly plan

screens.name: Home timeline
elements: On This Day row with streak badge
One row per month with progress pie; finished months struck through

screens.name: Swipe card
screens.purpose: Decide one photo at a time
elements: Photo card with KEEP/DELETE label while dragging
Side actions: favourite, bookmark, enhance, share

screens.name: Review grid
elements: 3-column grid, marked tiles tinted with trash badge

screens.name: Success
elements: Images deleted and space saved in this batch

screens.name: On This Day calendar
elements: Week grid with highlighted days that have photos

flows.name: Clean a month
steps: Swipe each photo right to keep, left to delete
Tap to go back if needed

flows.name: Daily memories
steps: Swipe through photos of this date

flows.name: Free tier wall
steps: Wait about 8 hours, watch an ad, or subscribe

data_model.storage: Photo library via PhotoKit; decisions and progress on device. Reviews report progress lost after an update.

monetization.price: Free download; weekly 4.99-9.99 USD (8 EUR in reviews), yearly 29.99-109.99 USD (79.99 EUR in reviews), monthly 4.99 USD; 3-day trial
paywalled_features: Unlimited deletions (free tier stops after a few, then waits about 8 hours)
monetization.notes: Soft paywall early in onboarding. Ads every few photos in the free tier.

user_pains.pain: Weekly or yearly price too high for a simple app
user_pains.evidence: 'Come può un app per svuotare foto costare 8€ alla settimana?', '79.99€ al anno'

user_pains.pain: Free tier stops after a handful of deletions, then waits hours
user_pains.evidence: '7 foto ogni 8 ore', 'Dopo aver cancellato UNA foto ... aspettare 8h'

user_pains.pain: Ads, and ads that never load blocking deletion
user_pains.evidence: 'Guarda un breve annuncio per eliminare… ma l'annuncio non parte mai'

user_pains.pain: Crashes or won't open after updates
user_pains.evidence: 'stuck on a monochrome screen', 'Ogni 2 minuti si blocca'

user_pains.pain: Progress lost or counts wrong; reviewed photos reappear
user_pains.evidence: 'ha tolto i mesi già cancellati, annullando settimane di lavoro', 'fa riapparire sempre foto già visualizzate'
'non ha avvisato dell'inizio di un abbonamento'

user_pains.pain: Videos don't play and phone heats up, causing wrong deletions
user_pains.evidence: 'non fa vedere i video quindi ne ho eliminati molti per sbaglio'
